message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time Zone) is normally **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
During daylight‑saving periods it’s **8 hours behind**.  

| Period | Los Angeles | Berlin | Difference |
|--------|-------------|--------|------------|
| Standard Time (winter) | UTC−08:00 | UTC+01:00 | −9 h |
| Daylight Saving Time (summer) | UTC−07:00 | UTC+02:00 | −8 h |

So if it’s 12:00 pm noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9:00 pm in Berlin during winter, and 8:00 pm during summer.
